title: Salvage the wreck
text: Tap Scavenge to pull scrap out of the escape pod's wreckage.

title: Build a Scrapyard
text: A sorting pit keeps scrap coming in without you tapping.

title: Put the survivors to work
text: Food is running out. In Crew, make one survivor a Grower and one a Scavenger.

title: Grow more food
text: Grow Tents feed people without needing a worker. More food means room to grow.

title: Make room for stragglers
text: Survivors only join if there's a bed. Build a Shelter.

title: Gather five survivors
text: Keep food positive and beds free. Newcomers arrive every minute or so.

title: Prepare for Deep Winter
text: Every fourth season, heat demand nearly triples. Build Burn Barrels before it comes.

title: Wake the flight computer
text: A Salvaged Terminal lets survivors study. Data pays for research.

title: Assign a Scholar
text: Scholars produce data. Research opens new jobs and buildings.

title: First discoveries
text: Research Prospecting and Lichen Culture in the Lab.

title: Mine and harvest
text: Put Miners on ore and Harvesters on biomass. You'll need both for metal.

title: Stack the stores
text: Storage caps limit what you can afford. Storage Crates raise them.

title: Distil fuel
text: Research Distillation and build a Distillery. Smelting needs fuel.

title: First metal
text: Research Smelting and build a Smelter. The crash pod's reactor can power exactly one.

title: Power the colony
text: A second Smelter overloads the pod. Research Photovoltaics and build Solar Arrays.

title: Keep the lights on in winter
text: Solar output halves in Deep Winter. Research Combustion: Biomass Burners work in the dark.

title: Glass and plastic
text: Glassworking and Polymers turn scrap, biomass and fuel into building materials.

title: Start over, stronger
text: Open Legacy and Rebuild. The colony starts over, but keeps Legacy (permanent bonuses), these goals and everything you unlocked with them.

title: Proper homes
text: Hab Modules house three survivors each. Shelters get expensive fast.

title: A real colony
text: Twenty survivors. Balance food, heat and beds as you grow.

title: Hand-etched logic
text: Research Circuitry, then craft circuits in Works.

title: Sign the charter
text: Research Colony Charter and choose a doctrine in the Lab. It shapes the rest of this run.

title: Alloy plates
text: Research Metallurgy and craft alloy plates.

title: Let the machines craft
text: Fabricators run auto-craft rules so components keep flowing.

title: Reactor theory
text: The last big idea before you can leave.

title: Engineers' Quarters
text: The people who build reactor cores need somewhere to sleep.

title: The first reactor core
text: Craft a Reactor Core in Works.

title: Light the Ignition Chamber
text: Research Controlled Ignition and build the chamber.

title: Ascend
text: Take the colony to orbit from the Legacy tab.
